description: This file defines the FFNetworkManager class and related classes/functions for managing network requests and responses in Firefox within the Playwright project. It handles request interception, response processing, and event handling for network activity.

classes.name: FFNetworkManager
classes.description: Manages network requests and responses for Firefox in Playwright.

classes.name: InterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an interceptable network request, including redirect handling.

classes.name: FFRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route handling for intercepted requests.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up resources.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a request is about to be sent.

methods.name: _onResponseReceived
methods.description: Handles the event when a response is received.

methods.name: _onRequestFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when a request has finished.

methods.name: _onRequestFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a request fails.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues an intercepted request with optional overrides.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills an intercepted request with a custom response.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts an intercepted request with an error code.
